about: A fresh sample of job titles for the tech role set, drawn on 2026-11-06 after the rules were written and never used to fix them. 300 from the census of 1,098 Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby boards, none already in titles_tech.json: 240 by plain keyword and 60 at random, seed 23 ('fresh-keyword', 'fresh-random'). 120 from postings the 2026-11-06 refresh kept on the other boards (Workday, Oracle, SuccessFactors and others), which passed the rules and so measure precision only ('fresh-kept'). Labelled by two model readers, each on every title, from the spec of the first labelling alone (PLAN.md, 'A third role set'), never the rules. They agreed on the role for 403 of 420 and on role, level, ladder and entry mark for 394. A row counts only where both were sure and agreed; the others carry sure=false and the two readings in the note. evals/run_pipeline.py --roles tech reports the rates and never fails on this file. A miss is fixed by adding a labelled row to titles_tech.json and fixing the rule there; this file stays as labelled.
